categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the power electronics sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of power electronic conversion and control equipment. Its main product lines include precision test power supplies, special power supplies, and power quality control devices. These products serve various industries such as new energy, aerospace, rail transit, scientific research, power distribution, and special equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies including high-density power conversion, high-precision intelligent control, and productization support platforms. It employs digital control systems based on FPGA, high-efficiency DC converter topologies, modular and reconfigurable power electronic circuit architectures, and multi-scenario simulation test power control technologies. Production methods include MTS (make to stock), ATO (assemble to order), and MTO (make to order) tailored to product characteristics, with some PCB assembly outsourced. The company emphasizes modular design, high-frequency switching, and intelligent digital control to enhance product performance and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in photovoltaic energy storage, new energy vehicles, aerospace, rail transit, scientific research institutions, and power grid companies. Notable clients are top Chinese inverter manufacturers, leading new energy vehicle producers, and major state-owned enterprises such as China National Railway Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and State Grid Corporation of China. The company also serves certification bodies and research institutes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with offices and subsidiaries in multiple cities including Xi'an, Suzhou, Beijing, and Hong Kong. It has begun expanding its overseas presence, focusing on Southeast Asia and Europe, leveraging authorized overseas agents and supporting domestic clients' overseas production and R&D facilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the power electronics supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of power electronic devices and systems. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and technical services to downstream customers. The company maintains a strict supplier qualification and dual certification system to ensure supply chain quality and stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on innovation in high-precision digital control, high-density power conversion, modular architectures, and intelligent power electronics. It pursues a dual-engine R&D model combining independent development and industry-academia collaboration. Key R&D projects include next-generation programmable power supplies, high-power density power quality products, and specialized power supplies for aerospace and scientific research. The company aims to extend technology upstream to key modules and downstream to industry-specific solutions, enhancing competitiveness and market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of power electronic products including precision test power supplies, special power supplies, and power quality control devices. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distributor channels, with direct sales focused on customized products and distributors aiding market expansion. Additional revenue comes from technical services and solutions related to these products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in power electronics, competing with international brands such as AMETEK, EA, and Chroma in precision test power supplies. It holds a strong position in the domestic market for special power supplies and power quality control equipment, especially in aerospace, rail transit, and new energy sectors. The company is recognized for its advanced technology platforms and has received multiple national and provincial technology awards, establishing a competitive edge in innovation and product quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 972 million, representing a 17.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 73.1 million, a decline of 47.26% due to increased R&D investment and market competition. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.37 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.78 billion. R&D expenditure accounted for 14.6% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company has steadily expanded production capacity and market reach, with a growing overseas footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-performance, and modular power electronic products with advanced digital control and intelligent features. Its products offer superior dynamic response, power density, and reliability, meeting stringent industry standards and customer requirements in high-tech fields such as aerospace, new energy, and scientific research. The company’s integrated hardware-software platforms enable rapid customization and system integration, providing tailored solutions that enhance customer value and foster long-term partnerships.
